summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K containing two announcements: participation in a Goldman Sachs investor conference on 2026/08/31, and a subsidiary's related-party acquisition of right-of-use assets from the parent. The asset lease transactions total NT$10.24 million, with right-of-use assets of NT$9.35 million, approved by the board on the same date. These are routine operational and lease-related matters, not a special situation. No strategic event, tender, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing has no deal terms relevant to control or shareholder value, and no risk-arb angle or regulatory overhang. What to watch: none; routine disclosure.
